guard.note: player and connection present: edit (name, symbol, x, y + 2, z) or add the waypoint at the waystone's position in WaypointsManager.getWaypoints().getList(), then XaeroMinimap.instance.getSettings().saveWaypoints(waypointsManager.getCurrentWorld()) inside try / catch IOException -> printStackTrace (the class's only saveWaypoints call; the Forge 1.1 three-argument overload is gone)

registrar("1").playToClient(WaystoneActivatedPayload.TYPE, STREAM_CODEC, handler) on the default registrar: NeoForge wraps the handler in MainThreadPayloadHandler, so addWaypoint runs on the client thread
the caller: with Xaero's Minimap loaded, every received WaystoneActivatedPayload (one per waystone activation, and per WaystoneUpdatedEvent to every player) -> addWaypoint(pos, name)
world.getContainer().getSession().getWorldManagerIO().saveWorld(world, flag): the world's own session's world IO writes that world as it is at the call

w2w2_waypoint_save_coalesce.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation of the ModSettings.saveWaypoints call in XaeronCompatibility.addWaypoint(BlockPos, String) (require 1, allow 1): the save is remembered (one per waypoint world, first-remembered order) and run at the end of the client tick (ClientTickEvent.Post) and before logout (ClientPlayerNetworkEvent.LoggingOut) / client level unload (LevelEvent.Unload), HIGHEST listeners on NeoForge.EVENT_BUS registered on first use; off the client thread, or without listeners, the save runs at once. Trade-off (off by default): the waypoint file is written once per client tick instead of at every waystone message. Runtime flag w2w2WaypointSaveCoalesce. Helper bons.furious.patch.w2w2_coo49.W2w2Saves.
